title: PARCER Profile
description: Persona·Audience·Rules·Context·Execution·Response — ESAA agent profile schema. Schema-versioned, validated at subagent startup and SubagentStop response.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema (e.g. 1.0). Profiles must validate against the schema version they declare.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent this profile governs.

agent_role.description: Canonical TACO role this agent plays in the orchestration hierarchy.

role.description: Free-text persona description — who this agent is and how it behaves.

identity_constraints.description: Hard behavioral constraints that define the agent's identity. Violations = output.rejected.

failure_default.description: What the agent must return when it cannot fulfill its task.
failure_default.default: Return JSON with status=failed and composite_score=0.0

primary.description: Who the primary consumer of this agent's output is.

calibration.description: Guidance on output format and level of detail for the primary audience.
calibration.default: Output must be parseable JSON, never prose.

hard.description: Non-negotiable rules. Output is rejected if any hard rule is violated.

soft.description: Preferred behaviors. Violations produce warnings, not rejection.

inject.description: Context elements to always inject before execution (e.g. blast_radius, VGP results).

never_inject.description: Context elements that must never be injected (e.g. full cargo check output).

execution.description: Ordered list of execution phases/steps this agent must follow.

schema_ref.description: Reference to the JSON Schema that the agent's response output must validate against.

content_type.description: MIME type of the response body.

valid_examples.description: Example payloads that must validate successfully.

invalid_examples.description: Example payloads that must fail validation with specific errors.
